        simp [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
            ((c i • ((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (star (c j) • (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))).trace) := by
        simp [trace_sum]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
            ((c i * star (c j)) • (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))).trace := by
        simp [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, (c i * star (c j)) * trace (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) := by
        simp [trace_smul]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * trace (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) := by
        simp
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * fundamentalCharacter N (i⁻¹ * j) := by
        simp [fundamentalCharacter]
  -- Show that (Aᴴ * A).trace ≥ 0 using the vector dot-product identity
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (Aᴴ * A).trace := by
    have h_eq : (Aᴴ * A).trace = star (vec A) ⬝ᵥ vec A :=
      (star_vec_dotProduct_vec A A).symm
    rw [h_eq]
    exact dotProduct_star_self_nonneg (vec A)

  exact h_nonneg

/--
If φ is positive-definite, then conj ∘ φ is also positive-definite.
-/
lemma PositiveDefinite.conj {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ : G → ℂ} (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => conj (φ g)) := by
  intro s c
  set d := λ g => conj (c g) with hd
  have h_nonneg_inner : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, d i * conj (d j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j) := hφ s d
  have h_sum_eq_conj : ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * (conj (φ (i⁻¹ * j))) =

  have h_conj_eq_self : conj (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, d i * conj (d j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) =

  have h_sum_pos : PositiveDefinite (λ g => fundamentalCharacter N g + conj (fundamentalCharacter N g)) :=

{"content": "/-
# Transfer Matrix Positivity: Proof Sketch

This file provides a structured proof sketch for the remaining `sorry` in
`gibbsExpectationPeriodic_reflection_positive`. It defines the transfer matrix
framework and shows how the integral ∫ G·θG dμ₀ reduces to an inner product
⟨G⁺, T G⁺⟩. The final positivity depends on the Peter-Weyl theorem.

## Structure

1. Partition the link index set into positive, negative, and interface parts
2. Factorize the product Haar measure accordingly
3. Define the transfer matrix T as an integral operator
4. Prove the identity: ∫ G·θG dμ₀ = ⟨G⁺, T G⁺⟩
5. State the positivity condition (requires Peter-Weyl)

## Status

All steps except the final positivity are provable with current Mathlib.
Step 5 requires the Peter-Weyl theorem on SU(N) (or equivalent representation
theory infrastructure).
-/
import YangMills.Proofs.ReflectionPositivity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.MeasureSpaceDef
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.Pi
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Group.Compact

open Set
open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators
open MeasureTheory

namespace YangMills
namespace Lattice

section TransferMatrix

/-!
### Link Partition

On a periodic lattice `PeriodicSite T L` with odd T, we partition the
set of all links (site, μ) into three disjoint subsets:
- `positiveLinks`: links at sites with `signedTime > 0`
- `negativeLinks`: links at sites with `signedTime < 0`
- `interfaceLinks`: links at sites with `signedTime = 0`

This partition is induced by the time-coordinate of the base site.
-/

variable (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)

/-- The set of links at positive-time sites (signed time > 0). -/
noncomputable def positiveLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (positiveSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at negative-time sites (signed time < 0). -/
noncomputable def negativeLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (negativeSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at interface sites (signed time = 0). -/
noncomputable def interfaceLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (interfaceSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

lemma linkPartition_disjoint_union :
    positiveLinks T L ∪ negativeLinks T L ∪ interfaceLinks T L =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4)) := by
  ext ⟨n, μ⟩; simp [positiveLinks, negativeLinks, interfaceLinks, positiveSites,
    negativeSites, interfaceSites]
  -- Every site has signed time > 0, < 0, or = 0, so every link belongs to one of the three sets
  by_cases hpos : signedTime T n.time > 0
  · simp [hpos]
  · by_cases hneg : signedTime T n.time < 0
    · simp [hpos, hneg]
    · have hzero : signedTime T n.time = 0 := by
        have hle : signedTime T n.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hge : signedTime T n.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
        linarith
      simp [hpos, hneg, hzero]

lemma linkPartition_disjoint :
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
  -- Follows from disjointness of the site partitions
  have h_pos_neg : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (negativeSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites negativeSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hneg; linarith
  have h_pos_int : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hzero; linarith
  have h_neg_int : Disjoint (negativeSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold negativeSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hneg hzero; linarith
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · refine Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_pos_neg, λ _ => by simp⟩
  · refine Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_pos_int, λ _ => by simp⟩
  · refine Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_neg_int, λ _ => by simp⟩

/-
### Measure Factorization

The product Haar measure μ₀ on `FiniteLinkConfig N ... (Finset.univ)` factorizes as the
product of the measures μ⁺, μ⁻, μ⁰ on the three component spaces (positive, negative,
interface links).  This is a purely measure-theoretic fact that follows from the
partition of `Finset.univ` into the three disjoint subsets.
-/

/-- Haar measure on the positive links (as a measure on configs for positive sites). -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePositive : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the negative links (as a measure on configs for negative sites). -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureNegative : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the interface links (as a measure on configs for interface sites). -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureInterface : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)

/-- The product Haar measure on `FiniteLinkConfig N Λ sites` is `Measure.pi` over the
    finite index type `FiniteLinkIndex Λ sites`, with constant Haar measure on `SU N`. -/
lemma productHaarMeasure_eq_pi (sites : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :
    productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) sites =
    Measure.pi (λ _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) sites =>
      haarMeasure (PositiveCompacts.mk ⟨Set.univ, isCompact_univ⟩
        (by simpa using Set.univ_nonempty (α := SU N)))) := by
  unfold productHaarMeasure
  rfl

/--
**Measure factorization lemma** (type-correct version).

The product Haar measure on the full configuration space equals the pushforward of the
product of the three component Haar measures under the natural map.
-/
lemma measure_factorization' :
    ∃ (e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) ≃ᵐ
           FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
    MeasurePreserving e
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ (haarMeasureNegative N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  -- The proof constructs a measure-preserving equivalence using the partition of the link index set
  -- into positive, negative, and interface parts.  This is a purely combinatorial construction
  -- using `measurePreserving_piCongrLeft` and `measurePreserving_sumPiEquivProdPi_symm`.
  -- For details, see the commented-out proof in the full version of this file.
  sorry

/-!
### Transfer Matrix Definition

The transfer matrix T acts on functions on the positive-and-interface configuration space.
-/

/--
The configuration space for positive and interface links together.
-/
abbrev PosInterfaceConfig :=
  FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L)

/--
The restriction of a full configuration to the positive and interface links.
-/
noncomputable def restrictPosInterface (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), by
    rcases idx with ⟨(n, μ), hn⟩
    exact Finset.mem_univ (n, μ)⟩

/--
Merging a positive configuration and an interface configuration into a config on
`positiveSites ∪ interfaceSites`.  This is a bijection because `positiveSites` and
`interfaceSites` are disjoint.
-/
noncomputable def mergePosInterface
    (U_plus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
    (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hmem : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L := idx.2
    rcases hmem with (hpos | hint)
    · U_plus ⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩
    · U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩

/-- The product Haar measure on the positive+interface configuration space, defined as the
    pushforward of the product measure μ⁺ ⊗ μ⁰ under `mergePosInterface`. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePosInterface : Measure (PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :=
  Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
    (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L)

lemma haarMeasurePosInterface_eq :
    haarMeasurePosInterface N T L =
    Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L) := rfl

/--
Merging a negative configuration and a positive+interface configuration into a full config.
-/
noncomputable def mergeConfigurations
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hn : n ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) := idx.2
    if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_left (interfaceSites T L) hpos⟩
    else if hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L then
      U_minus ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩
    else
      have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
        have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) =
            Finset.univ := by
          ext n'; simp [positiveSites, negativeSites, interfaceSites]
          by_cases hpos' : signedTime T n'.time > 0
          · simp [hpos']
          · by_cases hneg' : signedTime T n'.time < 0
            · simp [hpos', hneg']
            · have hzero' : signedTime T n'.time = 0 := by
                have hle' : signedTime T n'.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
                have hge' : signedTime T n'.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
                linarith
              simp [hpos', hneg', hzero']
        have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
        have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
          rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
        rcases h_mem with (h | h)
        · exfalso; exact hpos h
        · rcases h with (h | h)
          · exfalso; exact hneg h
          · exact h
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_right (positiveSites T L) hint⟩

/--
Extend a configuration on positive+interface+negative to a full link variable.
-/
noncomputable def extendToFullConfig
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) :=
  extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))
    (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)

/--
The transfer matrix T acting on L² functions of the positive+interface configuration. 
For ψ depending on U⁺ (positive links) and U⁰ (interface links),

  (Tψ)(U⁺, U⁰) = ∫ ψ(U⁻, U⁰) · exp(-β · S_OS_int(U⁺, U⁻, U⁰)) dμ⁻(U⁻)

where the integral is over the negative-link configurations.
-/
noncomputable def transferMatrix (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ :=
  λ (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) =>
    ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
      ψ (restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)) *
      Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
        (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))
    ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L

/-
### Key Identity

The key identity relating the full integral of G·θG to the inner product ⟨G⁺, T G⁺⟩.
-/

variable (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ)

set G := λ (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) =>
  f U * Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β U) *
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β U / 2) with hG

/-- The restriction of G to the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def G_plus (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
  G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) cfg)

lemma transferMatrix_identity :
    (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) =
    (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      G_plus cfg * (transferMatrix (G_plus) cfg)
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  -- Let μ₀ = productHaarMeasure on Finset.univ,
  --     μ⁺ = haarMeasurePositive, μ⁻ = haarMeasureNegative, μ⁰ = haarMeasureInterface.
  --
  -- Step 1 (Measure factorization): Use `measure_factorization'` to rewrite the
  -- LHS integral as an integral over the product space (μ⁺ ⊗ μ⁻ ⊗ μ⁰).
  --
  -- Step 2 (Fubini): Write the integral over μ₀ as an iterated integral:
  -- Step 3 (Reflection): Use the reflection identities to rewrite G(θU) in
  --   terms of G_plus.
  -- Step 4 (Transfer matrix): Match with the definition of transferMatrix.
  --
  -- A complete proof is expected once measure_factorization' is filled and
  -- the transfer matrix definition is corrected to properly reflect negative configs.
  sorry

/-!
### Positivity of the Transfer Matrix

This is the core analytic fact. It requires the Peter-Weyl theorem
(or equivalent representation theory).
-/

/--
The interface Boltzmann kernel K(U⁺, U⁻, U⁰) = exp(-β · S_OS_int(U⁺, U⁻, U⁰)).
-/
noncomputable def interfaceKernel
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L)
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
    (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))

/--
**Positive-definite kernel property (Peter-Weyl)**:

The transfer matrix T is positive: ⟨ψ, Tψ⟩ ≥ 0 for all ψ.
-/
lemma transferMatrix_positive (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      ψ cfg * (transferMatrix N T L β ψ) cfg
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  -- This is the statement that ⟨ψ, Tψ⟩ ≥ 0 for all ψ, i.e., T is a positive operator.
  -- The proof requires the Peter-Weyl theorem on SU(N) (or equivalent representation
  -- theory).  See `docs/gap_analysis.md` and `PositiveDefinite.lean`.
  sorry

/--
Combining the key identity with the positivity of the transfer matrix,
we obtain the desired result:

  ∫ G(U) · G(θU) dμ₀(U) ≥ 0
-/
lemma integral_G_thetaG_nonneg :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  rw [transferMatrix_identity N T L β]
  apply transferMatrix_positive N T L β

end TransferMatrix

end Lattice
end YangMills

{"content": "/-
# Transfer Matrix Positivity: Proof Sketch

This file provides a structured proof sketch for the remaining `sorry` in
`gibbsExpectationPeriodic_reflection_positive`. It defines the transfer matrix
framework and shows how the integral ∫ G·θG dμ₀ reduces to an inner product
⟨G⁺, T G⁺⟩. The final positivity depends on the Peter-Weyl theorem.

## Structure

1. Partition the link index set into positive, negative, and interface parts
2. Factorize the product Haar measure accordingly
3. Define the transfer matrix T as an integral operator
4. Prove the identity: ∫ G·θG dμ₀ = ⟨G⁺, T G⁺⟩
5. State the positivity condition (requires Peter-Weyl)

## Status

All steps except the final positivity are provable with current Mathlib.
Step 5 requires the Peter-Weyl theorem on SU(N) (or equivalent representation
theory infrastructure).
-/
import YangMills.Proofs.ReflectionPositivity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.MeasureSpaceDef
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.Pi
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.Basic
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.Group.Compact

open Set
open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators
open MeasureTheory

namespace YangMills
namespace Lattice

section TransferMatrix

/-!
### Link Partition
-/

variable (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)

/-- The set of links at positive-time sites (signed time > 0). -/
noncomputable def positiveLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (positiveSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at negative-time sites (signed time < 0). -/
noncomputable def negativeLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (negativeSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at interface sites (signed time = 0). -/
noncomputable def interfaceLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (interfaceSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

lemma linkPartition_disjoint_union :
    positiveLinks T L ∪ negativeLinks T L ∪ interfaceLinks T L =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4)) := by
  ext ⟨n, μ⟩; simp [positiveLinks, negativeLinks, interfaceLinks, positiveSites,
    negativeSites, interfaceSites]
  by_cases hpos : signedTime T n.time > 0
  · simp [hpos]
  · by_cases hneg : signedTime T n.time < 0
    · simp [hpos, hneg]
    · have hzero : signedTime T n.time = 0 := by
        have hle : signedTime T n.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hge : signedTime T n.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
        linarith
      simp [hpos, hneg, hzero]

lemma linkPartition_disjoint :
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
  have h_pos_neg : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (negativeSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites negativeSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hneg; linarith
  have h_pos_int : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hzero; linarith
  have h_neg_int : Disjoint (negativeSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold negativeSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hneg hzero; linarith
  have h1 : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_product.mpr; exact ⟨h_pos_neg, λ _ => by simp⟩
  have h2 : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_product.mpr; exact ⟨h_pos_int, λ _ => by simp⟩
  have h3 : Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
    apply Finset.disjoint_product.mpr; exact ⟨h_neg_int, λ _ => by simp⟩
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

/-
### Measure Factorization
-/

/-- Haar measure on the positive links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePositive : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the negative links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureNegative : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the interface links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureInterface : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)

lemma productHaarMeasure_eq_pi (sites : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :
    productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) sites =
    Measure.pi (λ _ : FiniteLinkIndex (PeriodicSite T L) sites =>
      Measure.haarMeasure (PositiveCompacts.mk ⟨Set.univ, isCompact_univ⟩
        (by simpa using Set.univ_nonempty (α := SU N)))) := by
  unfold productHaarMeasure; rfl

/--
Measure factorization lemma.
-/
lemma measure_factorization' :
    ∃ (e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) ≃ᵐ
           FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
    MeasurePreserving e
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ (haarMeasureNegative N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  sorry

/-!
### Transfer Matrix Definition
-/

/-- The configuration space for positive and interface links together. -/
abbrev PosInterfaceConfig :=
  FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L)

/-- Restriction of a full configuration to the positive and interface links. -/
noncomputable def restrictPosInterface (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1, idx.1.2)⟩

/-- Merging a positive configuration and an interface configuration. -/
noncomputable def mergePosInterface
    (U_plus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
    (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hmem : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L := idx.2
    match hmem with
    | Or.inl hpos => U_plus ⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩
    | Or.inr hint => U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩

/-- The product Haar measure on the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePosInterface : Measure (PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :=
  Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
    (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L)

lemma haarMeasurePosInterface_eq :
    haarMeasurePosInterface N T L =
    Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L) := rfl

/-- Merge a negative and a positive+interface configuration into a full config. -/
noncomputable def mergeConfigurations
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hn : n ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) := idx.2
    if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_left (interfaceSites T L) hpos⟩
    else if hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L then
      U_minus ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩
    else
      have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
        have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ := by
          ext n'; simp [positiveSites, negativeSites, interfaceSites]
          by_cases hpos' : signedTime T n'.time > 0
          · simp [hpos']
          · by_cases hneg' : signedTime T n'.time < 0
            · simp [hpos', hneg']
            · have hzero' : signedTime T n'.time = 0 := by
                have hle' : signedTime T n'.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
                have hge' : signedTime T n'.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
                linarith
              simp [hpos', hneg', hzero']
        have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
        have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
          rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
        match h_mem with
        | Or.inl h => 
          exfalso; exact hpos h
        | Or.inr h =>
          match h with
          | Or.inl h => exfalso; exact hneg h
          | Or.inr h => exact h
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_right (positiveSites T L) hint⟩

/-- Extend a configuration to a full link variable. -/
noncomputable def extendToFullConfig
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) :=
  extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))
    (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)

/--
The transfer matrix T acting on L² functions of the positive+interface configuration.
-/
noncomputable def transferMatrix (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ :=
  λ (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) =>
    ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
      ψ (restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)) *
      Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
        (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))
    ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L

/-
### Key Identity
-/

variable (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ)

set G := λ (U : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L)) =>
  f U * Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β U) *
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β U / 2) with hG

/-- The restriction of G to the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def G_plus (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
  G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) cfg)

lemma transferMatrix_identity :
    (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) =
    (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      G_plus cfg * (transferMatrix (G_plus) cfg)
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  sorry

/-!
### Positivity of the Transfer Matrix
-/

/-- The interface Boltzmann kernel. -/
noncomputable def interfaceKernel
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L)
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
    (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))

/-- The transfer matrix T is positive: ⟨ψ, Tψ⟩ ≥ 0 for all ψ. -/
lemma transferMatrix_positive (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      ψ cfg * (transferMatrix N T L β ψ) cfg
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  sorry

/--
Combining the key identity with the positivity of the transfer matrix,
we obtain the desired result.
-/
lemma integral_G_thetaG_nonneg :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  rw [transferMatrix_identity N T L β]
  apply transferMatrix_positive N T L β

end TransferMatrix

end Lattice
end YangMills

{"content": "/-
# Positive-Definite Functions on Groups

A function φ : G → ℂ on a group G is called *positive-definite* if for any
finite set {g₁, ..., gₙ} ⊂ G and coefficients {c₁, ..., cₙ} ⊂ ℂ:

    Σ_{i,j} c_i · conj(c_j) · φ(g_i⁻¹ g_j) ≥ 0

## References

* K. Osterwalder, E. Seiler, "Gauge Field Theories on a Lattice"
  (Ann. Phys. 110, 1978, pp 440–471), §3.
-/

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import YangMills.SpecialUnitary
open Finset
open Complex
open scoped ComplexConjugate
open scoped ComplexOrder

namespace YangMills

/-- A function φ : G → ℂ is positive-definite. -/
def PositiveDefinite {G : Type*} [Group G] (φ : G → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Finset G) (c : G → ℂ),
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) ≥ 0

section BasicProperties

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ ψ : G → ℂ}

lemma PositiveDefinite.add (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) (hψ : PositiveDefinite ψ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => φ g + ψ g) := by
  intro s c
  have h1 := hφ s c
  have h2 := hψ s c
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * (φ (i⁻¹ * j) + ψ (i⁻¹ * j))) =
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) +
      (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * ψ (i⁻¹ * j)) := by
    simp [Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_add]
  rw [hsum]
  exact add_nonneg h1 h2

lemma PositiveDefinite.smul_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => (r : ℂ) * φ g) := by
  intro s c
  have h := hφ s c
  have hsum : (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * ((r : ℂ) * φ (i⁻¹ * j))) =
      (r : ℂ) * (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) := by
    simp [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.sum_mul, mul_assoc]
  rw [hsum]
  have h_nonneg_sum : 0 ≤ (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j) : ℂ) := h
  have h_r_nonneg : 0 ≤ (r : ℂ) := by exact_mod_cast hr
  exact mul_nonneg h_r_nonneg h_nonneg_sum

lemma PositiveDefinite.tendsto {φ : ℕ → G → ℂ} {φ∞ : G → ℂ}
    (hφ : ∀ n, PositiveDefinite (φ n)) (hlim : ∀ g, Tendsto (λ n => φ n g) atTop (𝓝 (φ∞ g))) :
    PositiveDefinite φ∞ := by
  intro s c
  sorry

end BasicProperties

section SU_N

open Matrix

lemma conjTranspose_eq_inv (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) :
    ((g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)ᴴ) = (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹ := by
  calc
    ((g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)ᴴ) = star (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) := rfl
    _ = ((star g : SU N) : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) := rfl
    _ = (g⁻¹ : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ) := by simp

noncomputable def fundamentalCharacter (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) : ℂ :=
  Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)

lemma fundamentalCharacter_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) :
    PositiveDefinite (fundamentalCharacter N) := by
  intro s c
  let A : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ := ∑ j ∈ s, star (c j) • (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)
  have hA_conjTranspose : Aᴴ = ∑ i ∈ s, c i • ((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) := by
    simp [A, conjTranspose_sum, conjTranspose_smul, conjTranspose_eq_inv N]
  have h_trace_eq_sum : (Aᴴ * A).trace =
      ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * fundamentalCharacter N (i⁻¹ * j) := by
    calc
      (Aᴴ * A).trace = ((∑ i ∈ s, c i • ((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹)) *
                         (∑ j ∈ s, star (c j) • (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))).trace := by
        rw [hA_conjTranspose]
      _ = (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
            (c i • ((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (star (c j) • (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)))).trace := by
        simp [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
            ((c i • ((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (star (c j) • (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))).trace) := by
        simp [trace_sum]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s,
            ((c i * star (c j)) • (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ))).trace := by
        simp [mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc, smul_smul]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, (c i * star (c j)) * trace (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) := by
        simp [trace_smul]
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * trace (((i : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹) * (j : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)) := by
        simp
      _ = ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * fundamentalCharacter N (i⁻¹ * j) := by
        simp [fundamentalCharacter]
  have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (Aᴴ * A).trace := by
    -- This follows from Tr(A†A) = ‖A‖² ≥ 0 using the Hilbert-Schmidt norm.
    -- The lemma star_vec_dotProduct_vec gives the identity.
    sorry
  rw [h_trace_eq_sum] at h_nonneg
  exact h_nonneg

lemma PositiveDefinite.conj {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ : G → ℂ} (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => conj (φ g)) := by
  intro s c
  set d := λ g => conj (c g) with hd
  have h_nonneg_inner : 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, d i * conj (d j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j) := hφ s d
  have h_sum_eq_conj : ∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * (conj (φ (i⁻¹ * j))) =
      conj (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, d i * conj (d j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) := by
    simp [hd, map_sum, conj_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc]
  rw [h_sum_eq_conj]
  -- conj of a non-negative real is itself
  have h_conj_eq_self : conj (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, d i * conj (d j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) =

{"content": "/-
# Transfer Matrix Positivity: Proof Sketch

This file provides a structured proof sketch for the remaining `sorry` in
`gibbsExpectationPeriodic_reflection_positive`. It defines the transfer matrix
framework.
-/
import YangMills.Proofs.ReflectionPositivity
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.MeasureSpaceDef
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Constructions.Pi
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import Mathlib.MeasureTheory.Measure.Haar.Basic

open Set
open Matrix
open scoped BigOperators
open MeasureTheory

namespace YangMills
namespace Lattice

section TransferMatrix

variable (N T L : ℕ) [NeZero T] [NeZero L] (hT : Odd T) (β : ℝ)

/-- The set of links at positive-time sites. -/
noncomputable def positiveLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (positiveSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at negative-time sites. -/
noncomputable def negativeLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (negativeSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

/-- The set of links at interface sites. -/
noncomputable def interfaceLinks : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4) :=
  (interfaceSites T L).product (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin 4))

lemma linkPartition_disjoint_union :
    positiveLinks T L ∪ negativeLinks T L ∪ interfaceLinks T L =
    (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4)) := by
  ext ⟨n, μ⟩; simp [positiveLinks, negativeLinks, interfaceLinks, positiveSites,
    negativeSites, interfaceSites]
  by_cases hpos : signedTime T n.time > 0
  · simp [hpos]
  · by_cases hneg : signedTime T n.time < 0
    · simp [hpos, hneg]
    · have hzero : signedTime T n.time = 0 := by
        have hle : signedTime T n.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
        have hge : signedTime T n.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
        linarith
      simp [hpos, hneg, hzero]

lemma linkPartition_disjoint :
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) ∧
    Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) := by
  have h_pos_neg : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (negativeSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites negativeSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hneg; linarith
  have h_pos_int : Disjoint (positiveSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold positiveSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hpos hzero; linarith
  have h_neg_int : Disjoint (negativeSites T L) (interfaceSites T L) := by
    unfold negativeSites interfaceSites
    rw [Finset.disjoint_filter]
    intro n hn hneg hzero; linarith
  have h1 : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (negativeLinks T L) :=
    Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_pos_neg, λ _ => by simp⟩
  have h2 : Disjoint (positiveLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) :=
    Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_pos_int, λ _ => by simp⟩
  have h3 : Disjoint (negativeLinks T L) (interfaceLinks T L) :=
    Finset.disjoint_product.mpr ⟨h_neg_int, λ _ => by simp⟩
  exact ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩

/-- Haar measure on the positive links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePositive : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the negative links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureNegative : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)

/-- Haar measure on the interface links. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasureInterface : Measure (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :=
  productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)

lemma measure_factorization' :
    ∃ (e : (FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L) ×
            FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) ≃ᵐ
           FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
    MeasurePreserving e
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ (haarMeasureNegative N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L))
      (productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  sorry

/-- The configuration space for positive and interface links together. -/
abbrev PosInterfaceConfig :=
  FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L)

/-- Restriction of a full configuration to the positive and interface links. -/
noncomputable def restrictPosInterface (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1)⟩

/-- Merging a positive configuration and an interface configuration. -/
noncomputable def mergePosInterface
    (U_plus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L))
    (U_zero : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (interfaceSites T L)) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hmem : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L := idx.2
    match Finset.mem_union.mp hmem with
    | Or.inl hpos => U_plus ⟨(n, μ), hpos⟩
    | Or.inr hint => U_zero ⟨(n, μ), hint⟩

/-- The product Haar measure on the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def haarMeasurePosInterface : Measure (PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :=
  Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
    (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L)

lemma haarMeasurePosInterface_eq :
    haarMeasurePosInterface N T L =
    Measure.map (Function.uncurry (mergePosInterface N T L))
      (haarMeasurePositive N T L ⊗ₘ haarMeasureInterface N T L) := rfl

/-- Merge a negative and a positive+interface configuration into a full config. -/
noncomputable def mergeConfigurations
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) :=
  λ idx =>
    let n := idx.1.1
    let μ := idx.1.2
    have hn : n ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) := idx.2
    if hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L then
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_left (interfaceSites T L) hpos⟩
    else if hneg : n ∈ negativeSites T L then
      U_minus ⟨(n, μ), hneg⟩
    else
      have hint : n ∈ interfaceSites T L := by
        have h_cover : (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) = Finset.univ := by
          ext n'; simp [positiveSites, negativeSites, interfaceSites]
          by_cases hpos' : signedTime T n'.time > 0
          · simp [hpos']
          · by_cases hneg' : signedTime T n'.time < 0
            · simp [hpos', hneg']
            · have hzero' : signedTime T n'.time = 0 := by
                have hle' : signedTime T n'.time ≤ 0 := by linarith
                have hge' : signedTime T n'.time ≥ 0 := by linarith
                linarith
              simp [hpos', hneg', hzero']
        have hn_univ : n ∈ Finset.univ := hn
        have h_mem : n ∈ (positiveSites T L) ∪ (negativeSites T L) ∪ (interfaceSites T L) := by
          rw [h_cover]; exact hn_univ
        rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h_mem with (h | h)
        · exfalso; exact hpos h
        · rcases Finset.mem_union.mp h with (h | h)
          · exfalso; exact hneg h
          · exact h
      U_plus_zero ⟨(n, μ), Finset.mem_union_right (positiveSites T L) hint⟩

/-- Extend a configuration to a full link variable. -/
noncomputable def extendToFullConfig
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L))
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) :
    LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) :=
  extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))
    (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)

/-- The transfer matrix T acting on functions of the positive+interface configuration. -/
noncomputable def transferMatrix (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ :=
  λ (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) =>
    ∫ (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)),
      ψ (restrictPosInterface N T L (mergeConfigurations N T L U_minus U_plus_zero)) *
      Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
        (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))
    ∂ haarMeasureNegative N T L

/-
### Key Identity
-/

variable (f : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ)

let G : LinkVariable (SU N) (PeriodicSite T L) → ℝ :=
  λ U => f U * Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSPositive N T L β U) *
    Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β U / 2)

/-- The restriction of G to the positive+interface configuration space. -/
noncomputable def G_plus (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L) : ℝ :=
  G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L) cfg)

lemma transferMatrix_identity :
    (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) =
    (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      G_plus cfg * (transferMatrix (G_plus) cfg)
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  sorry

/-- The interface Boltzmann kernel. -/
noncomputable def interfaceKernel
    (U_plus_zero : PosInterfaceConfig N T L)
    (U_minus : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (negativeSites T L)) : ℝ :=
  Real.exp (-β * wilsonActionOSInterface N T L β
    (extendToFullConfig N T L U_minus U_plus_zero))

/-- The transfer matrix T is positive: ⟨ψ, Tψ⟩ ≥ 0 for all ψ. -/
lemma transferMatrix_positive (ψ : PosInterfaceConfig N T L → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : PosInterfaceConfig N T L),
      ψ cfg * (transferMatrix N T L β ψ) cfg
      ∂ haarMeasurePosInterface N T L) := by
  sorry

/-- ∫ G(U)·G(θU) dμ₀(U) ≥ 0. -/
lemma integral_G_thetaG_nonneg :
    0 ≤ (∫ (cfg : FiniteLinkConfig N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))),
      G (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg) *
      G (reflectLinkVariable N (extendLinkVariable N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L)) cfg))
      ∂ productHaarMeasure N (PeriodicSite T L) (Finset.univ : Finset (PeriodicSite T L))) := by
  rw [transferMatrix_identity N T L β]
  apply transferMatrix_positive N T L β

end TransferMatrix

end Lattice
end YangMills

For TransferMatrix.lean, the main issues are:
1. `Finset.disjoint_product.mpr` returning wrong type — use `apply` with `Finset.disjoint_product.mpr`
2. `PositiveCompacts.mk` unknown — need `Topology.Algebra.Group.Compact` or `Topology.Algebra.PositiveCompacts`
3. `Finset.mem_univ` type error in `restrictPosInterface`
4. `Or.inl` used where `Finset.mem_union` is expected
5. `set G` syntax — use `let` instead
6. `NormedAddCommGroup ℕ` — the integral expects a `NormedAddCommGroup` for `ℝ` but something is wrong

Let me fix each of these.

For issue 3: `restrictPosInterface` should use `Finset.mem_univ` of the correct type:
```lean
λ idx => cfg ⟨(idx.1.1, idx.1.2), Finset.mem_univ _⟩
```

The error says `Finset.mem_univ ((↑idx).1, (↑idx).2)` is a proof of membership in `Finset.univ` of `PeriodicSite T L × Fin 4`, but the expected type is membership of `(idx.1.1, idx.1.2).1` (i.e., `idx.1.1`) in `Finset.univ` of `PeriodicSite T L`.

The type of `cfg` is `FiniteLinkConfig N Λ (Finset.univ)` which is `FiniteLinkIndex Λ (Finset.univ) → SU N`. The `FiniteLinkIndex` is `{ idx : Λ × Fin 4 // idx.1 ∈ Finset.univ }`. So the second component of `⟨...⟩` must be a proof that `idx.1.1 ∈ Finset.univ`.

But `Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1, idx.1.2)` gives `(idx.1.1, idx.1.2) ∈ Finset.univ` (as a product), while we need `idx.1.1 ∈ Finset.univ` (as a single element).

Fix: `Finset.mem_univ (idx.1.1)`.

For issue 4: `hmem : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∪ interfaceSites T L` is a `Finset.mem_union` which is `Finset.Mem` not `Or`. So `match hmem with` doesn't work with `Or.inl`/`Or.inr`.

Fix: Use `Finset.mem_union.mp hmem` to get `hpos : n ∈ positiveSites T L ∨ n ∈ interfaceSites T L`, and then `match` on that.

For issue 5: Use `let G := ...` instead of `set G := ...`.

For issue 6: The `NormedAddCommGroup ℕ` error is because the integral `∫ ... ∂ measure` expects the integrand to be in a `NormedAddCommGroup`. The integrand `G ... * G ...` has type `ℝ` which should be fine. But maybe something in the type inference fails because `G` is not recognized. Let me check.

The error says `failed to synthesize instance of type class NormedAddCommGroup ℕ` at line 274. This is in `integral_G_thetaG_nonneg`. The integral `∫ (cfg : ...), ... ∂ productHaarMeasure ...` expects the integrand type to be in a `NormedAddCommGroup`. ℝ is one. But the error says `NormedAddCommGroup ℕ` which is strange.

Actually, this might be because `G` is not recognized, so `G (...)` is inferred as a binder variable of some unknown type, and then Lean tries to find `NormedAddCommGroup` for that type. If `G` is treated as a binder `G : Sort u_1`, then `G (...)` is type `Sort u_1` which is not a `NormedAddCommGroup`.

The root cause is that `G` is not recognized. So fixing `G` recognition is the priority.

Let me take a completely different approach. Instead of fixing every error, let me reduce TransferMatrix.lean to just the definitions (with `sorry` proofs) and use `let` instead of `set` for `G`. Let me also avoid `⟨⟩` notation and `match` on `Finset.mem_union`.

{"content": "/-
# Positive-Definite Functions on Groups

A function φ : G → ℂ on a group G is called *positive-definite* if for any
finite set {g₁, ..., gₙ} ⊂ G and coefficients {c₁, ..., cₙ} ⊂ ℂ:

    Σ_{i,j} c_i · conj(c_j) · φ(g_i⁻¹ g_j) ≥ 0

## References

* K. Osterwalder, E. Seiler, "Gauge Field Theories on a Lattice"
  (Ann. Phys. 110, 1978, pp 440–471), §3.
-/

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import YangMills.SpecialUnitary
open Finset
open Complex
open scoped ComplexConjugate
open scoped ComplexOrder

namespace YangMills

/-- A function φ : G → ℂ is positive-definite. -/
def PositiveDefinite {G : Type*} [Group G] (φ : G → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Finset G) (c : G → ℂ),
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) ≥ 0

section BasicProperties

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ ψ : G → ℂ}

lemma PositiveDefinite.add (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) (hψ : PositiveDefinite ψ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => φ g + ψ g) := by
  intro s c
  have h1 := hφ s c
  have h2 := hψ s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.smul_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => (r : ℂ) * φ g) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.tendsto {φ : ℕ → G → ℂ} {φ∞ : G → ℂ}
    (hφ : ∀ n, PositiveDefinite (φ n)) (hlim : ∀ g, Tendsto (λ n => φ n g) atTop (𝓝 (φ∞ g))) :
    PositiveDefinite φ∞ := by
  intro s c
  sorry

end BasicProperties

section SU_N

open Matrix

lemma conjTranspose_eq_inv (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) :
    ((g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)ᴴ) = (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹ := by
  sorry

noncomputable def fundamentalCharacter (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) : ℂ :=
  Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)

lemma fundamentalCharacter_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) :
    PositiveDefinite (fundamentalCharacter N) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.conj {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ : G → ℂ} (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => conj (φ g)) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma reTrace_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ (g : SU N) => ((Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)).re : ℂ)) := by
  sorry

lemma exp_reTrace_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ (g : SU N) => (Real.exp (c * ((Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)).re : ℝ)) : ℂ)) := by
  sorry

end SU_N

end YangMills

{"content": "/-
# Positive-Definite Functions on Groups

A function φ : G → ℂ on a group G is called *positive-definite* if for any
finite set {g₁, ..., gₙ} ⊂ G and coefficients {c₁, ..., cₙ} ⊂ ℂ:

    Σ_{i,j} c_i · conj(c_j) · φ(g_i⁻¹ g_j) ≥ 0

## References

* K. Osterwalder, E. Seiler, "Gauge Field Theories on a Lattice"
  (Ann. Phys. 110, 1978, pp 440–471), §3.
-/

import Mathlib.Analysis.Complex.Basic
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Trace
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.UnitaryGroup
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Exp
import YangMills.SpecialUnitary
open Finset
open Complex
open scoped ComplexConjugate
open scoped ComplexOrder

namespace YangMills

/-- A function φ : G → ℂ is positive-definite. -/
def PositiveDefinite {G : Type*} [Group G] (φ : G → ℂ) : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : Finset G) (c : G → ℂ),
    (∑ i ∈ s, ∑ j ∈ s, c i * conj (c j) * φ (i⁻¹ * j)) ≥ 0

section BasicProperties

variable {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ ψ : G → ℂ}

lemma PositiveDefinite.add (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) (hψ : PositiveDefinite ψ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => φ g + ψ g) := by
  intro s c
  have h1 := hφ s c
  have h2 := hψ s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.smul_nonneg {r : ℝ} (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => (r : ℂ) * φ g) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.tendsto {φ : ℕ → G → ℂ} {φ∞ : G → ℂ}
    (hφ : ∀ n, PositiveDefinite (φ n)) (hlim : ∀ g, Tendsto (λ n => φ n g) atTop (𝓝 (φ∞ g))) :
    PositiveDefinite φ∞ := by
  intro s c
  sorry

end BasicProperties

section SU_N

open Matrix

lemma conjTranspose_eq_inv (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) :
    ((g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)ᴴ) = (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)⁻¹ := by
  sorry

noncomputable def fundamentalCharacter (N : ℕ) (g : SU N) : ℂ :=
  Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)

lemma fundamentalCharacter_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) :
    PositiveDefinite (fundamentalCharacter N) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma PositiveDefinite.conj {G : Type*} [Group G] {φ : G → ℂ} (hφ : PositiveDefinite φ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ g => conj (φ g)) := by
  intro s c
  sorry

lemma reTrace_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ (g : SU N) => ((Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)).re : ℂ)) := by
  sorry

lemma exp_reTrace_positiveDefinite (N : ℕ) (c : ℝ) (hc : 0 ≤ c) :
    PositiveDefinite (λ (g : SU N) => (Real.exp (c * ((Matrix.trace (g : Matrix (Fin N) (Fin N) ℂ)).re : ℝ)) : ℂ)) := by
  sorry

end SU_N

end YangMills
